versions.changelog:
abm-launch-strategy v1.0.0

- Initial release of the launch-strategy skill, designed to help users plan SaaS product launches and feature announcements.
- Provides a step-by-step framework (ORB: Owned, Rented, Borrowed channels) for building awareness and converting interest into users.
- Outlines a five-phase launch process, from internal launch to full public release.
- Includes best practices and tactical guidance for Product Hunt launches.
- Emphasizes using product marketing context to tailor advice appropriately.
